Sam (AE): MedTech Labs needs a POC with Private/VPC access. They asked for: PrivateLink recommended, short TF/CFN snippet, example SG rules, Dedicated pool for 24h load test, and a 7-day API key. Can infra confirm handoff steps?
Priya (Solutions): Recommend PrivateLink for cross-account: simpler and avoids peering routes. Quick checklist: 2 private subnets (different AZs), interface endpoint created in their account, SG allowing 443 from app CIDR, provide VPCE ID + screenshots.
Hank (Infra): Acceptance flow: 1) we create endpoint service -> send service name 2) customer creates aws_vpc_endpoint (Interface) -> they share VPCE ID 3) we accept -> they validate DNS+SG. If they want peering instead, we'll need explicit route updates and NAT for outbound to our infra.
Ivy (SRE): Routing note: interface endpoints are ENIs: no route table changes required for calls to the endpoint. If they put ENIs into private subnets, ensure those subnets have normal egress (NAT or egress gateway) for other outbound needs. TGW: don't assume cross-VPC reachability to interface endpoints.
Priya (Solutions): TF snippet (paste into ticket):
```
resource "aws_security_group" "vpce_sg" {
  name        = "vpce-sg"
  description = "Allow app -> Redwood PrivateLink"
  vpc_id      = var.vpc_id
  ingress {
    from_port   = 443
    to_port     = 443
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = [var.app_cidr]
  }
}

resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "redwood" {
  vpc_id            = var.vpc_id
  service_name      = var.service_name
  vpc_endpoint_type = "Interface"
  subnet_ids        = var.private_subnet_ids
  security_group_ids = [aws_security_group.vpce_sg.id]
}
```
Sam (AE): They gave account 555666777888 and contact ops@medtechlabs.com. Can infra reserve Dedicated pool Friday 09:00 PT for 2 hours?
Hank (Infra): We'll tag traffic by account and reserve a slot. Need a test CIDR (e.g., 10.20.30.0/24) for SG. We'll issue a scoped API key with TTL=7d and tag it medtech-poc.
Ivy (SRE): Smoke tests: 1) verify ENIs in two AZs 2) nslookup api.redwood-inference.internal -> resolves to VPCE IPs if private DNS enabled 3) curl health endpoint: `curl -sS https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/health` 4) small load (5-10 rps) to confirm Dedicated routing.
orch-bot: Ticket POC-8891 created: Dedicated reserve (24h), PrivateLink service creation, API key TTL 7d.
Sam (AE): I'll confirm Friday with the customer and upload their SG screenshot once they create the VPCE. Thanks all!
